'''Terrib Igmusk''' was a [[Keteerian]] who worked as a [[hotel]] concierge for [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]. In [[34 ABY]], Igmusk was present in the [[casino]] while [[Resistance]] [[agent]]s [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] [[Mission to Canto Bight|searched]] for the [[Master Codebreaker]] there. When the pair rode a herd of [[fathier]]s through the [[casino]], Igmusk fled from the [[Species|animals]].

==Biography==
Terrib Igmusk was a [[Keteerian]] who worked as a [[hotel]] concierge for the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]]<ref name="Bucket's List Extra" /> in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> During the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]<ref name="Last Jedi">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VIII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Igmusk was lurking inside the [[casino]] and at one point stood with the [[alien]]<ref name="Bucket's List Extra" /> [[Glowen Faquidde]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

The Keteerian was speaking with a [[human]] near one of the casino's [[gambling]] tables when the Resistance [[agent]] [[Finn]] [[Mission to Canto Bight|searched]] for the casino patron known as the [[Master Codebreaker]]. Igmusk was still in the casino when Finn and his partner [[Rose Tico]] rode a herd of [[fathier]]s, which they had liberated from the racetrack, through one of the building's [[Viewport|windows]]. Igmusk fled from the [[Species|animals]] as they trampled through the building.<ref name="Last Jedi" />

==Personality and traits==
Igmusk had [[Color|brown]] skin and dark [[eye]]s.<ref name="Bucket's List Extra" />

==Equipment==
Igmusk wore a black [[Clothing|suit]] with a white shirt and brooch.<ref name="Bucket's List Extra" />

==Behind the scenes==
Terrib Igmusk first appeared in the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="Last Jedi" /> in which he was portrayed by [[Keith De'Winter]]. For the film, Igmusk's creature design was titled "K020." The character was first identified in the [[2019]] episode guide for "[[Dangerous Business]]," an episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. In the "Bucket's List Extra" section of the episode guide, Terrib was misspelled as "Teerib."<ref name="Bucket's List Extra" />
